1.consolidated_definition: tur. Empresa o grupo dedicado a la preparación de excursiones o viajes. Frecuente. DRAE: desde 2001. De otra parte, en caso de que se radique una querella contra una empresa, concesionario u operador turístico, Turismo podrá representar al querellante e investigar, expedir citaciones, y celebrar vistas para ventilar las querellas (El Nuevo Día, 11-11-02)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tourism Agency or Group: A company or group dedicated to the preparation of excursions or trips. Frequently used since 2001 (DRAE). In addition, in cases where a complaint is filed against a tourism-related business, concessionaire, or operator, Tourism may represent the complainant and investigate, issue summonses, and hold hearings to address complaints (El Nuevo Día, November 11, 2002)
